messages:
paul: heads-up saw a cluster of fncall schema rejects for catalog-ingest. console shows big red error count but responses were arrays, not objects. product thinks requests failed.
anya: can you paste a sample?
paul: log: validator_error: expected object, got array; sample='[{"sku":"Z9","stock":4}]'
joel: note we rolled stricter fncall validation in a canary yesterday. fallback to cheaper model is enabled for rejects.
sumi: billing currently charges the model that actually ran (final_model_id). observability increments the origin route's validation_reject metric, which is why counts and charge don't match.
anya: UX idea: add a "soft-fallback" state (amber) in the console for validation->fallback flows showing origin_route + billed_model + a redacted sample.
joel: metric change: emit validation_event.kind=hard|soft|coercion and tags origin_route_id/execution_model_id/counts_for_billing. also add soft_fallback_rate with a 5%/15m alert.
sumi: policy: add per-route fncall_shape_policy: strict|soft|coerce. "coerce" allows adapter to wrap arrays -> {items: array}. default enterprise=soft.
paul: rollout caveat: exclude soft/coercion events from auto-flip triggers. auto-flip should only consider fatal rejects and capacity fallbacks to avoid surprise flips.
anya: action items: (1) telemetry tags & soft_fallback metric (anya) (2) console soft-fallback state + sample popover (paul) (3) validator reason codes + coercion hint (joel) (4) adapter coercion opt-in + per-route flag (sumi) (5) billing wording + FAQ (paul + finance).
deploy-bot: deploy 1799999000-fncall-validator-canary -> succeeded (canary eu-west)
paul: thanks — if a route hits >10% soft-fallback before changes, paste top 3 samples here and @eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
